component.name: Asura
component.summary: Terminal workspace with an AI agent, browser, and developer tools

description.p: Asura is a native desktop terminal workspace with an integrated AI agent, embedded browser, and developer tools. One window holds your terminals, remote servers, Docker containers, Kubernetes clusters, databases, files, Git repositories, and system monitors.

The agent runs in-process inside the desktop app and connects to remote hosts over standard SSH. Every mutation it proposes needs your approval, and pressing any key takes the terminal back immediately.
